name: Forward Raymarching Volume Rendering
definition: A forward raymarching volume rendering technique that samples a 3D texture along view rays, supporting Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP) and threshold-based isosurface rendering with gradient-based Phong lighting.
summary: Forward Raymarching Volume Rendering is a Three.js technique supporting MIP and threshold-based isosurface modes, differing from standard compositing by accumulating maximum intensity or terminating early for gradient-based Phong lighting.
